name: Cookies & Cream Latte
caffeineNote: No figure published for this can; the three linemates we have checked print 200 mg on the label
summary: Cookies-and-cream latte sold in Bones' flavored-latte line alongside their Cannoli, French Toast and S'mores cans, at the same 11 oz and $36.99 for twelve. The brand publishes no nutrition panel for this one, so its figures stay blank here until we check a can. Their Cookies N' Dreams Latte is a separate, sweeter can from the cold brew line.
